Title: Code Search Relevance And Performance Suite
Content: MemorySmith code search now enforces quality and performance guardrails beyond single-query tuning. The ranking path in CodeSearchService uses synonym-aware token expansion, hybrid vector and lexical reranking, and a no-lexical-evidence penalty to reduce false semantic positives. Results are diversified with MaxResultsPerDocument so one file cannot flood top-k. The automated suite now includes focused regressions in CodeSearchServiceTests for screwdriver and multi-query scorecard checks, plus benchmark smoke outputs that report top-hit spotchecks and warm-query latency averages. This provides a stable operator-facing quality contract while preserving sub-millisecond warm-query performance on the benchmark fixture.
